description: This PHP file sets locale settings, manages user authentication (for 'mso' and 'admin' users), handles session creation, redirects based on authentication, and includes detailed logic for IP validation and localization. It appears to be part of a web-based UI with security and internationalization features, possibly for a router or network device management interface.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Checks if the client IP is within the local network or containerized environment.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a network interface.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Determines whether an IP address belongs to the LAN, CM, or Rg network segment.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a user session, setting locale and timeout, and establishes user login context.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for OAuth authentication given an endpoint and redirect URI.
